text:
River,

You grew up without a blueprint and built a life anyway. Chose Cambridge, chose your people, chose to stay — and you treat all of it as though it's unremarkable, as though everyone assembles a home out of sheer nerve and stubbornness and then refuses to be impressed by their own architecture.

I notice this. I notice most things about you, which is either endearing or forensic depending on your tolerance, but the point is: you are extraordinary and you'd fight me on that word, and I'd lose happily.

I love you. Stubbornly, if that helps.

Gale
